children: Yields on U.K. government bonds rise by more than their eurozone equivalents ahead of a sale of the January 2056 gilt via syndication. Concerns about the U.K.'s stretched public finances and uncertainty around the government's fiscal plans ahead of the October 28 budget are causing investors to demand a risk premium on U.K. government bonds. Tuesday's transaction will be a measure of investors' appetite for gilts. Ten-year gilt yields climb 2.4 basis points to last trade at 5.197%, Tradeweb data show. Ten-year Bund yields rise 1.3 bps to 3.394%. (miriam.mukuru@wsj.com)
